data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement is an artifact of a tool failure. The Qwen model encountered HTTP 400 errors when trying to audit the PKGBUILD and .nvchecker.toml, resulting in an 'inconclusive' verdict. The DeepSeek model successfully audited these files and found them to be safe.
coverage_issues: Qwen model failed to review PKGBUILD and .nvchecker.toml due to LLM API HTTP 400 errors.
learnings: When orchestrating multiple models, an API failure in one should not force an overall 'inconclusive' verdict if another model successfully covers the missing files.
Implement retry logic or fallback mechanisms for transient LLM API errors (like HTTP 400) to prevent incomplete audits and unnecessary escalations.
